subject: Mutual action plan: Legal redline ownership & TAT for MSA/DPA/SLA
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@finexa.com>, Lara Singh <lara.singh@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP action: legal redlines (owners + TAT)

Hi Tom / Lara —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the immediate MAP milestone we discussed: the next gating item for your procurement timeline is legal review and redlines on our MSA/DPA/SLA. To keep the deal on the cadence you outlined (target close: 2027-07-15), we need to agree owners and expected turnaround times for each document.

I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_v1.xlsx) with suggested milestones — open to edits. Specific ask: can you confirm who on your side will own review for each doc and whether you can commit to a 3-business-day turnaround for initial redlines? If 3 days is tight, please propose an alternative.

Suggested responsibilities (from our side):
- Legal: Marissa Cole — primary reviewer and redline owner (2 business days turnaround for first pass)
- Commercial/DR: Ben Carter — pricing/terms interface and signoff (1 business day)
- Sales/Coordination: me (Camila) — MAP updates, escalation, and packaging for legal

Dependencies we called out in the MAP: finalized security questionnaire answers (we shared Finexa_Risk_QA.pdf), any bespoke data residency clauses, and whether you require SLA modifications beyond our standard.

Next steps: if you confirm owners + TAT by end of day tomorrow, I will update the MAP and send an official DocuSign routing for the MSA once legal is aligned.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Finexa_Risk_QA.pdf (pdf)

From: Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@finexa.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Singh <lara.singh@finexa.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP action: legal redlines (owners + TAT)

Camila —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. We can own the first pass on our side. Assigning people below: 
- Legal owner: Lara Singh (contracts lead) — will aim for 3 business days for an initial redline but depends on scope.
- Security/Privacy: I will coordinate with our InfoSec and confirm any additional data residency asks by EOD Wednesday.

Two quick clarifications:
1) If your Marissa proposes changes to our standard indemnity clause, what is your expected internal review time after we send redlines?
2) Do you have a preferred DocuSign order (legal first, then commercial)?

I'll confirm owners internally and circle back if we need to stretch the TAT to 5 business days for more material language.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Procurement | Finexa Analytics
Tom.Wallace@finexa.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP action: legal redlines (owners + TAT)

Tom / Camila —

Thanks Tom. Quick answers:
- Internal review cadence: I can commit to a 2-business-day turnaround for reacting to your initial redlines on the MSA/DPA/SLA, provided we stay within the scope of line edits and standard clauses. If new commercial economics or novel security commitments are requested, that will likely expand the window to 4–6 business days while I loop in Product and Security.
- DocuSign order: Legal -> Commercial (preferred). Saves us a second round of signatures if pricing/tables are unchanged after legal cleanup.

Actioning now: I will take point on our first-pass edits for the MSA and will upload a marked copy to the shared Drive (link below) by EOD tomorrow if I have your confirmation on owners/TAT. Ben — I may need you to confirm pricing language for any SLA penalties we alter.

Camila — please set the MAP to reflect Marissa (legal, 2bd), Ben (commercial, 1bd), Finexa legal (Lara, 3bd tentative). Also flag security dependency for InfoSec answers.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo recap + MAP action: legal redlines (owners + TAT)

Tom/Lara —

Thanks for confirming. Per Marissa's note I updated the MAP and uploaded a marked copy to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B1MAP-Redline-Docs (see the "Legal_Redline_Routing" tab in MAP_v1.xlsx). Summary of the agreed routing and timings (added to MAP):

- Finexa: Lara Singh — initial redline on MSA/DPA/SLA (target 3 business days from receipt)
- Redwood Legal: Marissa Cole — internal reaction to Finexa redlines (target 2 business days; 4–6bd if new commercial/security items appear)
- Redwood Commercial: Ben Carter — price/SLR table confirmation (1 business day after legal clears)

If Lara can send their redlines by EOD Thursday (23 Jun), Marissa will upload our counter-marked MSA by EOD Monday (27 Jun). That keeps us on track for DocuSign routing the week of 6/28 and a target close of 7/15.

I've also created a single-line escalation path in the MAP: if any redline materially changes indemnity, data residency, or SLA financial exposure, Camila (me) will escalate to VP Sales and Legal for expedited review.

Next ask: Tom, please confirm whether Finexa needs any specific SSL/data segregation language beyond what we included in Finexa_Risk_QA.pdf. If not, I'll kick off DocuSign routing once we exchange redlines.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai
